svg.title: What dynamic policies forecast
svg.desc: Three paradigm-level input/output views: Video WAMs, target-centric predictors, and FoveaWAM. Bold Current denotes a single RGB-D frame, paired with separate target SE(3) history. The middle and right panels share identical target trajectory geometry and size. FoveaWAM adds coarse sparse 3D scene flow. Future readouts supervise FoveaWAM training and are skipped at inference. Recorded geometry illustrates representations; target glyphs and displacements are enlarged. RGB illustrations use Blender renders of the same recorded states with presentation lighting and materials, not model predictions or actual policy camera pixels. The depth thumbnail and geometric future panels retain their original recorded sources.
